brief.summary: Grown-up, warm-toned polish with one clever twist: chocolate, camel and check worn tonal, a crisp white shirt or fine knit with wide pleated trousers or a midi skirt, and a single unexpected detail (lace hem peeking out, a feathered lapel, a contrast cuff, an embellished check). Easy, never stiff; low pointed heels and soft leather bags.
signatures: chocolate knit over an embellished check midi skirt with strappy black sandals
long chocolate wool coat over a burgundy crew knit and cream trousers
check bomber with faux-fur collar, matching pleated check midi skirt, belted, brown knee boots
tweed cropped jacket over a silk tie-neck blouse and wide brown pleated trousers
crisp white oversized shirt with a pinstripe pencil midi skirt and lace hem
camel cardigan jacket over a lace-trim top with wide chocolate trousers
slouchy leather pouch bag in burgundy or black
chunky hoop and statement earrings, pearls, tortoiseshell sunglasses
pointed kitten heels and slim brown boots
palette: a hit of green or blue
